jira_status.label: Jira issue status identifying periodic tasks

jira_frequency_field.label: Jira custom field key for the task frequency

frequency_map.label: Frequency label to RRULE map (for example FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=8;BYMINUTE=0). A cron expression is refused (AG-67).

resume_session.label: Resume the task's previous session (1, default) or start every periodic task run with a fresh session (0). The run stays in the task's thread either way.
